description: This file contains utility functions used in build scripts and recipes including environment checks, combining JSON property definitions, and creating a mini-mirror of files for deployment processes.

methods.name: checkEnv
methods.description: Checks that each provided environment variable is set and not empty; exits with error if any are missing.

methods.name: combinePropertyDefs
methods.description: Merges multiple property definition JSON files into a single aggregated JSON file.

methods.name: createMiniMirror
methods.description: Creates a minimized version of a directory with essential files for deployment, including branding and OOB contents.
